You are a careful, neutral coder of the REALIZED OUTCOME of a corporate transaction
over the 3-5 years AFTER it closed. You are given ONE evidence slice assembled from
public primary sources (financial filings, reputable press) that describes ONLY the
post-deal trajectory -- how the combined company actually fared. You are
DELIBERATELY NOT shown how the deal was structured at closing (what transferred and
what did not), and you must NOT speculate about the deal's structure. Code STRICTLY
the documented realized outcome. If the slice does not let you determine a field,
you MUST return "uncertain" -- never guess, never infer from outside knowledge.

Emit a single structured record with these fields.

C. FAILURE-PATHWAY INCIDENCE -- code strictly from the DOCUMENTED OUTCOME at the
3-5 year horizon. A pathway is a REALIZED DISRUPTION OVER TIME, not a structural
property of the deal.
  p4_pathway: Is there documented disruption specifically at the product/process
    interface (the acquired product could not be aligned with the operating
    processes over time; product-line/operations incoherence realized after the
    deal)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented; uncertain.
  p5_pathway: Is there documented fracture specifically at the process/organization
    interface (operations vs people/management/culture; integration of operations
    broke against the organization over time)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented;
    uncertain.
  t1_archetype: Is there documented incoherence in the controlling-intent archetype
    itself as it played out (e.g. an announced "merger of equals" that operated as
    one-sided dominance)? A channel SEPARATE from the product/process and
    process/organization pathways. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.
  t2_model: Is there documented incompatibility of the two business models
    (value-capture logics that could not be reconciled over time)? A channel
    SEPARATE from the pathways above. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

D. performance_metric: the single best-documented post-deal outcome scalar in the
   slice (e.g. "divested 80.1% after ~108 months", "~$99bn goodwill write-down",
   "no divestiture; assets retained"). One short phrase. If none, "not documented".

rationale: 2-4 sentences citing the slice lines that drove your p4_pathway and
p5_pathway codes specifically. Cite ONLY realized-outcome evidence; do NOT reason
about how the deal was structured at closing.

Emit ONLY the structured record. Code conservatively: absence of documented
evidence for a pathway is 0 (not-documented); inability to determine is "uncertain".

> EVIDENTIARY STANDARD: every factual line ends with a `[SRC: <SEC accession / URL>]`
> tag pointing to a public primary source. A fact that cannot be so sourced is written

> record over the fixed ~2021-2023 outcome window following the transaction. It contains
> no information about how the transaction was structured at closing.

## Public-reporting status in the outcome window (feasibility-relevant)
- CIK 0000039677 (AV Homes, Inc.) filed no Form 10-K, 20-F, or other annual/periodic
  report at any point after its Form 10-K for fiscal year 2017 (filed February 23,
  2018); its EDGAR filing history contains no annual report covering or filed within
  the ~2021-2023 outcome window. [SRC: https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0000039677&type=10-K&dateb=&owner=include&count=40]
- No audited standalone financial statements or other periodic disclosure exists for
  AV Homes, Inc. as a distinct reporting entity in the outcome window; its operations
  became part of Taylor Morrison Home Corporation (CIK 0001562476) following the 2018
  transaction. [SRC: https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0000039677&type=10-K&dateb=&owner=include&count=40]

## Acquirer's disclosure of the acquired business over the window
- Taylor Morrison Home Corporation's Form 10-K for fiscal year 2022 (filed February 22,
  2023) organizes its business into four reportable segments defined by geography
  (East, Central, West) plus a Financial Services segment; no segment or disclosure
  category is defined by, or separately attributed to, the AV Homes business. [SRC: SEC accession 0001628280-23-004524, Form 10-K FY2022]
- That FY2022 filing's only textual reference to AV Homes is in a tax-footnote
  discussion of Section 382 net-operating-loss limitations, identifying the "2018
  acquisition of AV Homes" as one of three historical ownership-change events
  constraining use of net operating losses; no operating or financial metric specific
  to the acquired business is disclosed. [SRC: SEC accession 0001628280-23-004524, Form 10-K FY2022]
- Taylor Morrison's Form 10-K for fiscal year 2021 (filed February 23, 2022) references
  the "acquisition of AV Homes, Inc." only in connection with 2019 transaction-expense
  recognition, reports the same geography-based reportable-segment structure, and lists
  its consumer-facing brand names as "Taylor Morrison, Darling Homes Collection by
  Taylor Morrison, and Esplanade" with no reference to AV Homes or its community brands
  (e.g., Solivita); the filing also describes its 55-plus buyer product line as
  "55-plus active lifestyle (formerly referred to as active adult)" without attributing
  that product line to a specific predecessor entity. [SRC: SEC accession 0001628280-22-003466, Form 10-K FY2021]

## Items noted but not primary-verifiable within window
- General industry and company press describing Taylor Morrison's acquisition history
  and integration approach exists, but the identified coverage either predates the
  outcome window (contemporaneous with the October 2018 closing) or postdates it
  (2026 retrospective commentary); none of it isolates a financial or operating
  scalar for the AV Homes business specifically within the ~2021-2023 window, so no
  press-sourced outcome scalar is recorded here. [UNVERIFIED]

## Outcome summary (realized record only)
- AV Homes, Inc. filed no periodic report after fiscal year 2017; across the
  ~2021-2023 window, Taylor Morrison's Form 10-K filings report results only by
  geographic segment and
  consolidated total, with the acquired business named just once, in a tax footnote,
  and never isolated by a financial or operating figure. No public 3-5-year record of
  the acquired business's realized trajectory as a distinct entity exists in the
  filings reviewed. [SRC: SEC accession 0001628280-22-003466, Form 10-K FY2021] [SRC: SEC accession 0001628280-23-004524, Form 10-K FY2022]

[SLICE END]
